branch_scope: The first five instructions are unchanged; final JZ +10 selects code_end when taken and the next RIP (code_end-10) when not taken. The admitted MOV RBX,imm64 suffix lies beyond the emitted Jcc-terminated block and is outside the measured native call.
cache_and_mapping_policy: No translation-cache lookup or cache entry. One MAP_JIT PublishedCode mapping at a time; publication is separate from repeated execution; each budget mapping is dropped before publishing the other.

calibration.wall_bound_derivation: Uses the current distinct-jz-fallthrough fixture profile and the same 200ms side floor, 16,777,216-call ceiling, 3s measured-side ceiling, 180s process ceiling, and 256-call checkpoint interval. Repetitions are calibrated afresh for both budgets and cases; no legacy-profile timing projection is reused.

compile_timer_boundary: compile_block_with_register_homes: block build/decode, lowering, allocation, ARM64 emission, finalization, and destruction of each unpublished CompiledBlock within the timed compile batch; excludes allocator-summary reconstruction, publication, execution, input reset and validation
execution_timer_boundary: Repeated PublishedCode::execute_block calls over one published artifact. The timer includes the safe host wrapper/context setup, generated entry call, and result copy/decode; state-vector creation and full-state/exit validation are outside the timer. The interpreter uses the same initial state and code bytes. For distinct-jz-fallthrough, the single compiled block ends at Jcc; no dispatcher traversal or MOV RBX suffix is timed.
exit_normalization: Keep native BlockComplete and interpreter InstructionBudgetExhausted tags distinct. Require full LongModeState parity, six retired instructions, zero remaining budget, ZF matching the case, and the case-specific expected RIP (taken code_end; not-taken fallthrough at code_end-10). The native block ends at Jcc; the suffix is not executed or included in timed calls.
publication_timer_boundary: PublishedCode::publish_block and PublishedCode drop are timed and reported separately. The mapping remains live for warmup/timing; drop occurs after execution timing and before the other budget is published. These durations are never added to compile or execution samples.
sample_floor_policy: Retain every raw sample. A compile or execution side below 200ms sets sample_floor_passed=false and classifies the full process as diagnostic-only; no samples are trimmed and no comparison result should be scored.
scope: One frozen six-instruction register-only multi-helper block with distinct JZ taken/fallthrough RIPs; alternating register-homes budget4 versus diagnostic budget0 allocator-configuration pairs. The admitted fallthrough MOV is outside the measured block. This does not isolate marginal spill cost or choose an allocator algorithm globally.

variants.publication_lifetime: one preflight publication; dropped before next budget
